title: MEXT says procurement information system server was accessed without authorization; a maximum of 163,953 records may have leaked
date_note: Date of the ministry announcement per ITmedia; the ministry says it detected the access on 1 October.
org: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
geo_basis: national ministry; Tokyo as seat of government
summary: ITmedia reports that MEXT announced on 25 November that the server of its Government Procurement Information System was accessed without authorization. A maximum of 163,953 records, including company and representative names, and a maximum of 1,778 email addresses may have leaked. The ministry says it detected the access on 1 October and has not confirmed publication or misuse.
plain: Japan's education ministry said a server of its procurement information system was accessed without authorization. A maximum of 163,953 records of company and representative data may have leaked; it has not confirmed misuse.
exec: MEXT says a maximum of 163,953 records of business data and a maximum of 1,778 email addresses may have leaked from a procurement system.

evidence.quote: メールアドレス最大1778件が外部に漏えいした可能性があると発表した。
